statements.t: “With GlyphAllo and GlyphAgo, Seaport is now advancing two Phase 2 programs, and we look forward to progressing these programs through a steady cadence of potential value-creating milestones.

“In parallel, we are preparing to initiate the Phase 2/3, potentially registration-enabling trial of GlyphAgo in GAD in the first half of next year, and we expect topline data from both Phase 2 trials of GlyphAgo in 2028 – with data from the Phase 2a trial expected in early 2028, and data from the Phase 2/3 trial expected by year-end 2028.

risks.t: risks that interim results are not predictive of final results in a clinical trial
Seaport’s ability to execute on its strategy including obtaining the requisite regulatory approvals on the expected timeline, if at all
uncertainties relating to preclinical and clinical development activities
Seaport’s ability to attract, integrate, and retain key personnel
risks related to regulatory developments and approval processes of the FDA and comparable foreign regulatory authorities
risks related to establishing and maintaining Seaport’s intellectual property protections
risks related to the competitive landscape for Seaport’s product candidates
